sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, the two agreeing. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description; where the description states no location, step or target, the guide says so instead of inventing one. Counts the official description does not state (42 Shooting Range challenges, 9 activity types, 14 drone race locations, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garage properties, 500 choices) are the tracked counts the official list carries, as Exophase and PSNProfiles list them.

roadmap_stages.name: Story playthrough
roadmap_stages.note: Chapters, story missions and character finales, in the order the list presents them. Every trophy in this stage is tied to one story beat, so earn it when that beat runs.

roadmap_stages.name: Activities and side challenges
roadmap_stages.note: Races, the Shooting Range, fishing, arcade, bowling, robberies and the rest — counts the descriptions set, no story window.

roadmap_stages.name: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap_stages.note: Cards, vehicles, areas and garage properties — found across Leonida, no story window.

roadmap_stages.name: Cleanup and platinum
roadmap_stages.note: 100% completion, the vague trophies that resolve on their own, and the platinum itself.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task for it. Work the roadmap stages in order and this trophy pops with the last trophy you earn.
